description: Read metric sensor depth at a selected visible pixel in an original RGB observation from the active task, CURRENT or HISTORY. Uses that observation's paired depth, no detector or segmentation model. Returns the source observation, acquisition time, depth validity and a marked evidence image. A historical sample describes the earlier viewpoint, not current distance. Coordinates use the original scene bounds, not a resized preview or map. Sensor depth is not horizontal or target-reference distance; target identity and completion remain visual judgments.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id on the CURRENT or HISTORY original RGB to measure, from this active task.

pixel_x.description: Zero-based column in the original RGB, increasing to the right; must be less than scene width.

pixel_y.description: Zero-based row in the original RGB, increasing downward; must be less than scene height.
